description: Expected results for the official DuMux example examples/1ptracer (DuMux releases/3.10, commit 3e151aeb, 3.10.0-11): steady single-phase flow on a 50x50 unit square with a seeded random permeability field, then 500 steps of tracer transport to t=5000 s. Field values come from the OFFICIAL DuMux test-suite reference files test/references/test_1ptracer_pressure-reference.vtu and test_1ptracer_transport-reference.vtu, which the DuMux ctest 'example_1ptracer' compares against with the official fuzzy-compare script (relative 1e-2, absolute 1.5e-7*max).
engine_version: DuMux 3.10 (releases/3.10 commit 3e151aebf005bf500c0d0e05563c0e8c41583eef) with DUNE 2.10; server build of example_1ptracer

numeric_checks.name: p_min
numeric_checks.why: min pressure [Pa] of the 1p stage (official reference test_1ptracer_pressure-reference.vtu); tol = official DuMux fuzzy-compare relative tolerance 1e-2

numeric_checks.name: p_max
numeric_checks.why: max pressure [Pa] of the 1p stage (official reference); tol = official DuMux fuzzy-compare relative tolerance 1e-2

numeric_checks.name: p_mean
numeric_checks.why: mean cell pressure [Pa] of the 1p stage (official reference); tol = official DuMux fuzzy-compare relative tolerance 1e-2

numeric_checks.name: permeability_mean
numeric_checks.why: mean of the seeded random permeability field [m^2] (official reference); shows the grid and random field are the same; tol = official DuMux fuzzy-compare relative tolerance 1e-2

numeric_checks.name: tracer_x_max_end
numeric_checks.why: max tracer mole fraction at t=5000 s (official reference test_1ptracer_transport-reference.vtu); tol = official DuMux fuzzy-compare relative tolerance 1e-2

numeric_checks.name: tracer_x_mean_end
numeric_checks.why: mean tracer mole fraction at t=5000 s (official reference); falls slightly below the start value as tracer leaves at the outflow side; tol = official DuMux fuzzy-compare relative tolerance 1e-2

numeric_checks.name: velocity_max
numeric_checks.why: max cell velocity magnitude [m/s] at t=5000 s (official reference); tol = official DuMux fuzzy-compare relative tolerance 1e-2

numeric_checks.name: velocity_mean_y
numeric_checks.why: mean vertical velocity [m/s] (official reference); main flow is bottom to top; tol = official DuMux fuzzy-compare relative tolerance 1e-2

numeric_checks.name: fuzzy_fail_pressure
numeric_checks.why: official DuMux fuzzycompare (legacy backend, rel 1e-2, abs 1.5e-7*max) of 1p.vtu vs test_1ptracer_pressure-reference.vtu, every field and cell; 0 = equal

numeric_checks.name: fuzzy_fail_transport
numeric_checks.why: official DuMux fuzzycompare of example_1ptracer-00010.vtu vs test_1ptracer_transport-reference.vtu (the files the DuMux ctest compares); 0 = equal

numeric_checks.name: n_time_steps
numeric_checks.why: TEnd 5000 s / dt 10 s (params.input); last 'Time step N done' line

numeric_checks.name: final_time_s
numeric_checks.why: TimeLoop.TEnd in params.input; time on last step line

numeric_checks.name: n_tracer_vtu
numeric_checks.why: output every 500 s check point, t=0..5000 (own run; the ctest compares file -00010)

numeric_checks.name: tracer_x_mean_start
numeric_checks.why: initial tracer mole fraction mean at t=0 (own run): 1e-9 in the bottom 10% of cells = 1e-10 domain mean

finished_check: return code 0 and the model's own line 'Simulation took ... seconds' at the end of stdout
recorded_with: run_reference.py through KI tools/run_dumux.py run_simulation; engine /home/server/knowledge-dissection-toolkit/auto_dissect/_work/DuMux/dumux/dumux/build-cmake/examples/1ptracer/example_1ptracer; DUMUX_NUM_THREADS=4
notes: Run command = official ctest command plus -Problem.FlowDirection 1. The server binary was built from a KI-edited problem_1p.hh whose default (FlowDirection 0) is left-right flow; with the default it crashes at step 136 (BiCGSTAB defect=inf). FlowDirection 1 selects the unedited official bottom-top code path; the full-field fuzzy compare against the official references proves the results are the official ones. An unedited build ignores the key.
Our run vs official references: pressure, permeability, max tracer and max velocity identical to all printed digits; tracer mean differs by 1.5e-8 relative, mean vertical velocity by 1.7e-9 relative.
Two runs (default 192 OpenMP threads and 4 threads) gave byte-identical output files.

2026-10-06: values unchanged. The server default is now a clean build of the official commit (/home/server/engine_builds_20261006/dumux/src/build-cmake/dumux/examples/1ptracer/example_1ptracer); it passes all checks with the official command (no FlowDirection key), and its output files are byte-identical to the older build run with -Problem.FlowDirection 1. run_reference.py adds that key only with --flow-direction-flag on.
